name: Performance Investigation
description: Investigate a performance complaint, compare explanations, and independently verify an improvement or an evidence-based no-change decision.
when_to_use: Use when a reported latency, throughput, or resource problem needs reproducible measurements before choosing a code change.

stages.title: Reproduce and benchmark: {goal}
stages.description: Reproduce {goal}. Record the exact input revision, environment, representative workload, repeated measurements, and variance in a baseline artifact. Run `{test_command}` as appropriate. If the complaint cannot be reproduced with available data, state the gap and request the missing workload rather than inventing a baseline.
acceptance: Baseline includes workload, environment, exact input revision, and repeatable measurements

stages.title: Profile bottlenecks: {goal}
stages.description: Profile the baseline without changing shared code. Rank bottlenecks and cite artifacts.

stages.title: Investigate alternatives: {goal}
stages.description: Independently investigate alternative explanations and define tests that could disprove them.

stages.title: Choose and implement improvement: {goal}
stages.description: Act as the sole implementation owner. Compare the profile and alternative hypotheses, explain contradictions, and choose a bounded candidate only when the evidence justifies one. Edit only in a registered isolated workspace. Compare the candidate against the baseline and run `{test_command}`. Bind evidence to the exact resulting revision. If no safe improvement is supported, retain the input revision and record a reasoned no-change decision.
acceptance: The implementation or no-change decision is supported by comparative measurements and resolves the competing findings

stages.title: Verify improvement and regressions: {goal}
stages.description: Independently inspect the exact candidate revision, or unchanged input revision for a no-change decision. Run `{test_command}` and the same benchmark workload. Do not edit source code or publish a change. Produce a local review artifact with comparison, variance, regression checks, and remaining uncertainty. Record failed evidence and a durable finding if the proposed result is unsupported; do not claim an improvement from an inconclusive measurement.
acceptance: Final artifact independently verifies the exact result or no-change decision against the baseline and records remaining uncertainty
